descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
We're continuously growing our Data & Analytics practice and are looking for professionals with experience in Data Engineering, Data Warehousing, BI and Analytics.
 Our projects span multiple technologies and cloud environments, including Databricks, Azure, AWS and Power BI, and we regularly open new opportunities across the entire data lifecycle.
 Whether you build data pipelines, design data warehouses, develop BI solutions or work with modern cloud data platforms, we'd love to connect and explore where your experience could fit within our growing portfolio.
 What you'll do 
Design and build scalable data pipelines that power analytics, reporting and business-critical applications.
Develop and optimize modern data platforms in cloud environments.
Work with large volumes of data, integrating information from multiple systems and sources.
Design and implement data warehouse solutions, data models and reporting layers.
Enable business teams with reliable, high-quality data and actionable insights.
Automate, monitor and improve data processing workflows and platform performance.
Collaborate with architects, software engineers, analysts and business stakeholders to solve complex data challenges.
Contribute to the modernization of enterprise data ecosystems, leveraging cloud-native technologies and best practices.
 Technologies we work with 
 Depending on the project, you may have the opportunity to work with:
 Databricks 
 Azure Data Factory 
 Azure Synapse Analytics 
 Microsoft Fabric 
 AWS (Redshift, Glue, EMR, S3, Lambda) 
 Power BI 
 SQL & T-SQL 
 PySpark & Spark 
 Python 
 ETL / ELT frameworks 
 Data Warehousing & Dimensional Modeling 
 Lakehouse Architectures 
 CI/CD and DevOps practices for Data Platforms 
 What we're looking for 
Experience in Data Engineering, Data Warehousing, BI, Reporting or Analytics projects.
Strong SQL skills and a good understanding of data modeling concepts.
Hands-on experience with at least one modern cloud platform (Azure, AWS or GCP).
Exposure to technologies such as Databricks, Power BI, Fabric, Synapse, Redshift, Snowflake or similar.
Passion for solving business problems through data.
Strong collaboration and communication skills.
Good English proficiency.
 Why join us? 
 You'll have the opportunity to work on diverse data initiatives across industries, using modern technologies and cloud platforms, while contributing to projects that help organizations make better decisions, improve operations and accelerate digital transformation.
 This is not a single-role opening. We're continuously expanding our Data & Analytics practice and are always interested in connecting with talented professionals across the data spectrum.
